words.enDefinition: the supermarket aisle where milk and other dairy products are sold

examples.en: I went back to the dairy aisle for yogurt after finding the bread.
examples.zh: 找到面包后，我回到「乳制品货架区」拿酸奶。

examples.en: The staff moved the dairy aisle closer to the fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 店员把「乳制品货架区」搬到了更靠近果蔬的地方。

collocations: find something in the dairy aisle

words.enDefinition: milk from which little or none of the natural fat has been removed

examples.en: I bought whole milk because it was the only small carton left.
examples.zh: 我买了「全脂牛奶」，因为只剩这种有小盒装。

examples.en: My flatmate put whole milk on the list for our weekend pancakes.
examples.zh: 室友把「全脂牛奶」写进了周末做薄煎饼的购物清单。

words.enDefinition: milk with some but not all of its fat removed, especially in the UK

examples.en: I picked up semi-skimmed milk from the shelf below the large cartons.
examples.zh: 我从大盒牛奶下面那层货架上拿了「半脱脂牛奶」。

examples.en: The café asked if I wanted semi-skimmed milk in my hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆问我要不要在热巧克力里加「半脱脂牛奶」。

words.enDefinition: milk from which nearly all of the fat has been removed

examples.en: I bought skim milk in a small bottle for cereal in the morning.
examples.zh: 我买了一小瓶「脱脂牛奶」，早上泡麦片。

examples.en: The coffee stand ran out of skim milk just before the morning break.
examples.zh: 上午课间休息前，咖啡摊正好用完了「脱脂牛奶」。

words.enDefinition: milk treated at an ultra-high temperature and packaged for a long unopened shelf life

examples.en: I found UHT milk in the grocery aisle beside the cartons of juice.
examples.zh: 我在杂货通道的果汁盒旁边找到了「超高温灭菌牛奶」。

examples.en: My flatmate keeps a carton of UHT milk in the cupboard for weekends.
examples.zh: 室友在柜子里放了一盒「超高温灭菌牛奶」，周末用。

words.enDefinition: milk dried into a powder that can be mixed with water or used in cooking

examples.en: I bought powdered milk in a small bag for the bread recipe.
examples.zh: 我买了一小袋「奶粉」，用来做面包。

examples.en: The recipe called for powdered milk alongside yeast, flour and a little sugar.
examples.zh: 食谱需要「奶粉」、酵母、面粉和少量糖。

words.enDefinition: concentrated milk made by removing part of its water, generally without added sugar

examples.en: The dessert recipe called for evaporated milk rather than a carton of cream.
examples.zh: 甜点食谱需要「淡炼乳」，没用盒装奶油。

examples.en: I found evaporated milk beside the tins of coconut cream at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在超市的椰浆罐头旁边找到了「淡炼乳」。

collocations: use evaporated milk in a dessert

words.enDefinition: milk concentrated by removing water and sweetened with added sugar

examples.en: I used sweetened condensed milk for the iced coffee we made at home.
examples.zh: 我们在家做冰咖啡时，我用了「加糖炼乳」。

examples.en: The shop sells sweetened condensed milk in small cans next to the baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 商店在烘焙食材旁边卖小罐装的「加糖炼乳」。

collocations: a tin of sweetened condensed milk

words.enDefinition: a tangy milk product used in baking and cooking, often made by culturing milk

examples.en: I added buttermilk to the batter for the pancakes we made on Saturday.
examples.zh: 周六做薄煎饼时，我往面糊里加了「酪乳」。

examples.en: The small shop stocked buttermilk beside the cream and other baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 小店把「酪乳」和奶油等烘焙食材放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: a rich British cream with a high milk-fat content, often used for whipping or desserts

examples.en: I bought double cream to serve with the berries after our group dinner.
examples.zh: 我买了「高脂浓奶油」，在小组聚餐后和浆果一起端上桌。

examples.en: The recipe calls for double cream to make the filling rich and smooth.
examples.zh: 食谱用「高脂浓奶油」让馅料口感浓郁顺滑。

words.enDefinition: a British cream with less fat than double cream, used for pouring or cooking

examples.en: I bought single cream to stir into the soup we were serving.
examples.zh: 我买了「英式稀奶油」，打算搅进要端上桌的汤里。

examples.en: The supermarket put single cream in small cartons next to the milk.
examples.zh: 超市把小盒装的「英式稀奶油」放在牛奶旁边。

words.enDefinition: a rich North American cream with enough milk fat to whip well

examples.en: The pastry recipe asked for heavy cream to make the chocolate filling.
examples.zh: 糕点食谱用「高脂淡奶油」做巧克力馅。

examples.en: I found heavy cream in the refrigerated section by the half-and-half cartons.
examples.zh: 我在冷藏区半奶半奶油的盒子旁边找到了「高脂淡奶油」。

collocations: add heavy cream to a sauce

words.enDefinition: a North American dairy mixture of milk and cream, often added to coffee

examples.en: The breakfast counter had half-and-half in a small jug near the cups.
examples.zh: 早餐柜台的杯子旁放着一小壶「牛奶与奶油混合乳」。

examples.en: I added half-and-half to my coffee because the milk jug was empty.
examples.zh: 装牛奶的壶空了，我就往咖啡里加了「牛奶与奶油混合乳」。

words.enDefinition: cream cultured to give it a thick consistency and slightly sour taste

examples.en: I put a spoonful of sour cream on each baked potato at dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭时，我在每个烤土豆上加了一勺「酸奶油」。

examples.en: The sour cream was in the same cooler as the cream cheese.
examples.zh: 「酸奶油」和奶油奶酪放在同一个冷柜里。

words.enDefinition: a cultured cream with a rich texture and mild tang, used in French cooking

examples.en: I stirred crème fraîche into the mushroom sauce just before serving dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭端上桌前，我将「法式酸奶油」拌进了蘑菇酱。

examples.en: The shop keeps crème fraîche in small pots near the plain yogurt.
examples.zh: 这家店把小杯装的「法式酸奶油」放在原味酸奶旁边。

words.enDefinition: very thick British cream with a rich texture, traditionally served with scones

examples.en: The small café served warm scones with jam and clotted cream on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日小咖啡馆供应热司康，配果酱和「凝脂奶油」。

examples.en: I bought a pot of clotted cream for our afternoon tea at home.
examples.zh: 我买了一罐「凝脂奶油」，准备在家喝下午茶时用。

collocations: spread clotted cream on a scone

words.enDefinition: a soft, smooth fresh cheese that is often spread or used in baking

examples.en: I spread cream cheese on a bagel before leaving for my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 出门上早课前，我在贝果上抹了「奶油奶酪」。

examples.en: The recipe needed cream cheese for the frosting on the carrot cake.
examples.zh: 这份食谱要用「奶油奶酪」做胡萝卜蛋糕的糖霜。

words.enDefinition: a fresh cheese made of soft individual curds, often with a little liquid

examples.en: My roommate mixed cottage cheese with chopped herbs for our baked potatoes.
examples.zh: 室友把「茅屋奶酪」和切碎的香草拌在一起，配烤土豆吃。

examples.en: I found cottage cheese next to the yogurt in the supermarket cooler.
examples.zh: 我在超市冷柜的酸奶旁找到了「茅屋奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: yogurt with no added flavourings, such as fruit or vanilla

examples.en: I bought plain yogurt to use in both breakfast and a salad dressing.
examples.zh: 我买了「原味酸奶」，早饭和做沙拉酱都能用。

examples.en: The recipe uses plain yogurt to give the sauce a lighter texture.
examples.zh: 食谱用「原味酸奶」让酱汁口感更轻盈。

words.enDefinition: a thick yogurt traditionally made by straining away some of its liquid

examples.en: I served Greek yogurt with chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey.
examples.zh: 我在「希腊式浓酸奶」上撒了碎核桃，淋了点蜂蜜。

examples.en: The sandwich filling used Greek yogurt to keep the mixture thick and creamy.
examples.zh: 三明治馅用了「希腊式浓酸奶」，拌出来黏稠顺滑。

words.enDefinition: a fermented milk drink traditionally made with a mixed culture of bacteria and yeast

examples.en: I tried kefir for the first time with fruit from the breakfast bar.
examples.zh: 我第一次喝「开菲尔发酵乳」，配着早餐台上的水果。

examples.en: The convenience store sells kefir in small bottles beside the other yogurt drinks.
examples.zh: 便利店把小瓶装「开菲尔发酵乳」和其他酸奶饮品放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: milk made suitable for a lactose-free diet by removing or breaking down its lactose

examples.en: I bought lactose-free milk because a guest asked for it with breakfast.
examples.zh: 有客人想在早餐时喝「无乳糖牛奶」，我就买了一盒。

examples.en: The campus shop carries lactose-free milk in the same cooler as whole milk.
examples.zh: 校内商店把「无乳糖牛奶」和全脂牛奶放在同一个冷柜。

words.enDefinition: a milk-like drink made from oats and water

examples.en: The coffee stand asked whether I wanted oat milk in my usual latte.
examples.zh: 咖啡摊问我平时喝的拿铁要不要加「燕麦奶」。

examples.en: I used oat milk because it was the only carton open in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我用了「燕麦奶」，因为冰箱里只有那一盒开过封。

words.enDefinition: a milk-like drink made from plant ingredients such as oats, soy or nuts

examples.en: The café lists plant-based milk options on a separate card by the till.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆在收银台旁的一张卡上单独列出了几种「植物奶」。

examples.en: We bought plant-based milk for a guest who requested a dairy alternative.
examples.zh: 有客人想喝奶制品替代饮料，我们就买了「植物奶」。

words.enDefinition: butter to which salt has been added

examples.en: I used salted butter on the bread we shared with the soup.
examples.zh: 我们喝汤配面包，我抹了「有盐黄油」。

examples.en: The corner shop had salted butter but no other kind that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，街角商店只有「有盐黄油」，没有别的黄油。

words.enDefinition: butter made without added salt

examples.en: The recipe called for unsalted butter in the crust and the filling.
examples.zh: 食谱说饼皮和馅料都要用「无盐黄油」。

examples.en: I bought unsalted butter so I could adjust the seasoning myself later.
examples.zh: 我买了「无盐黄油」，之后可以自己调整咸淡。

words.enDefinition: butter or a butter blend made soft enough to spread readily

examples.en: My flatmate prefers spreadable butter for toast when we have early lectures.
examples.zh: 我们早上有课时，室友喜欢用「易涂抹黄油」抹吐司。

examples.en: I bought a tub of spreadable butter instead of a wrapped block.
examples.zh: 我买的是一盒「易涂抹黄油」，没有买纸包的整块黄油。

words.enDefinition: a butter-like spread usually made from vegetable oils

examples.en: I used margarine to grease the tin before making the banana loaf.
examples.zh: 我做香蕉面包前，用「人造黄油」给烤模抹了油。

examples.en: The recipe notes that margarine can be used in some versions of the cake.
examples.zh: 食谱注明，这种蛋糕有些做法可以用「人造黄油」。

words.enDefinition: a type of clarified butter made by cooking butter and separating out the milk solids

examples.en: I found ghee on the shelf beside the other cooking oils and spices.
examples.zh: 我在货架上其他食用油和香料的旁边找到了「南亚式澄清黄油」。

examples.en: My flatmate used a little ghee when making rice for our shared meal.
examples.zh: 室友给我们做饭时，在煮饭里用了一点「南亚式澄清黄油」。

words.enDefinition: cheese sold as a solid block rather than sliced or shredded

examples.en: I bought block cheese so I could cut thick slices for the sandwiches.
examples.zh: 我买了「整块奶酪」，这样能切厚片夹三明治。

examples.en: The chilled shelf had block cheese alongside packets of ready-cut slices.
examples.zh: 冷藏货架上有「整块奶酪」，旁边还有切好片的袋装奶酪。

collocations: cut a piece of block cheese

words.enDefinition: cheese cut or grated into long thin pieces

examples.en: I sprinkled shredded cheese over the potatoes before serving them to my flatmates.
examples.zh: 给室友端上土豆前，我撒了些「刨丝奶酪」。

examples.en: The shop sold bags of shredded cheese beside the blocks of cheddar.
examples.zh: 商店把袋装「刨丝奶酪」放在一块块切达奶酪旁边。

collocations: sprinkle shredded cheese over a dish

words.enDefinition: a piece of cheese in a triangular shape cut from a larger piece

examples.en: I chose a small cheese wedge for the picnic because there were only three of us.
examples.zh: 去野餐的只有我们三个人，所以我选了个小「楔形奶酪块」。

examples.en: The deli wrapped the cheese wedge in paper so it would fit in my bag.
examples.zh: 熟食柜台用纸包好「楔形奶酪块」，这样能放进我的包。

words.enDefinition: a firm cheese originally from England, sold in mild and stronger varieties

examples.en: I sliced some cheddar for the sandwiches we packed before our trip.
examples.zh: 出门前准备三明治时，我切了几片「切达奶酪」。

examples.en: The café uses cheddar in its toasted sandwiches with tomato and onion.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的烤三明治夹了「切达奶酪」、番茄和洋葱。

words.enDefinition: a mild cheese with a soft or stretchy texture, often used on pizza

examples.en: I added mozzarella to the pizza we made in our shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在共用厨房做比萨时，我放了「马苏里拉奶酪」。

examples.en: The shop stocks mozzarella in both balls and bags of pre-grated cheese.
examples.zh: 商店既卖球形的「马苏里拉奶酪」，也卖磨好装袋的。

words.enDefinition: a hard Italian-style cheese with a strong flavour, often grated over food

examples.en: I grated parmesan over the pasta just before taking the bowls to the table.
examples.zh: 把面端上桌前，我刨了点「帕玛森奶酪」撒在意面上。

examples.en: The server offered parmesan to the students who had ordered the tomato pasta.
examples.zh: 服务员问点了番茄意面的学生要不要加「帕玛森奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: a crumbly brined cheese originating in Greece, typically made with sheep's milk

examples.en: We crumbled feta over cucumber and tomato for our lunch in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们午饭在花园吃，把「菲达奶酪」捏碎撒到黄瓜和番茄上。

examples.en: The grocery shop sells feta in a small packet near the olives.
examples.zh: 杂货店在橄榄旁卖小包装的「菲达奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: a soft mild Italian cheese traditionally made from the whey left after cheesemaking

examples.en: I used ricotta in the filling for the pasta shells we cooked together.
examples.zh: 我们一起煮贝壳面时，我用「里科塔奶酪」做馅。

examples.en: The recipe recommended ricotta instead of cream cheese for a lighter texture.
examples.zh: 为了让口感更轻盈，食谱推荐用「里科塔奶酪」代替奶油奶酪。

words.enDefinition: a firm Cypriot cheese that holds its shape when heated

examples.en: Our café sandwich came with grilled halloumi, peppers and a little spinach.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆给我们的三明治夹了烤「哈罗米奶酪」、甜椒和一点菠菜。

examples.en: I sliced the halloumi before putting it on the grill with the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我先把「哈罗米奶酪」切片，再和蔬菜一起放上烤架。

words.enDefinition: cheese with blue or green veins of mould and a distinctive strong flavour

examples.en: The cheese plate included blue cheese and two kinds I recognized immediately.
examples.zh: 奶酪拼盘里有「蓝纹奶酪」，还有两种我一下就认出来的奶酪。

examples.en: I added a little blue cheese to the dressing for our salad.
examples.zh: 我往沙拉酱里加了一点「蓝纹奶酪」。

words.enDefinition: the outer layer that forms or is added to some cheeses

examples.en: The deli worker told me which part was the cheese rind on that wedge.
examples.zh: 熟食柜台店员告诉我，那块奶酪哪部分是「奶酪外皮」。

examples.en: I removed the cheese rind before grating the rest into the sauce.
examples.zh: 我先去掉「奶酪外皮」，再把其余部分磨碎拌到酱里。

words.enDefinition: eggs from hens raised in a system that provides access to the outdoors

examples.en: I picked up free-range eggs from the shelf under the mixed-size cartons.
examples.zh: 我从混合规格蛋盒下方的那层架子拿了「散养鸡蛋」。

examples.en: The campus café lists free-range eggs on its breakfast menu for the weekend.
examples.zh: 校内咖啡馆把「散养鸡蛋」列在周末早餐菜单上。

words.enDefinition: eggs from hens housed without cages, which may be indoors

examples.en: The label marks these as cage-free eggs and shows a barn on the front.
examples.zh: 标签注明这些是「非笼养鸡蛋」，正面还画了一座鸡舍。

examples.en: I compared the price of cage-free eggs with the smaller box beside them.
examples.zh: 我把「非笼养鸡蛋」的价格和旁边小盒装鸡蛋的价格作了比较。

words.enDefinition: a container with individual spaces that hold eggs in place

examples.en: I opened the egg carton to check the eggs before putting it in my basket.
examples.zh: 我打开「鸡蛋包装盒」检查里面的蛋，然后才把它放进篮子。

examples.en: The eggs came in a cardboard egg carton with the size printed on top.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋装在纸质「鸡蛋包装盒」里，盒顶印着规格。

words.enDefinition: a quantity of twelve eggs, often sold in one carton

examples.en: I bought a dozen eggs because we were cooking breakfast for several people.
examples.zh: 我们要给好几个人做早餐，所以我买了「一打鸡蛋」。

examples.en: The corner shop sold a dozen eggs for less than the campus store.
examples.zh: 街角小店卖「一打鸡蛋」比校内商店便宜。

collocations: a carton of a dozen eggs

words.enDefinition: the yellow central part of an egg

examples.en: I brushed the pastry with egg yolk before putting it in the oven.
examples.zh: 把酥皮点心放进烤箱前，我刷了层「蛋黄」。

examples.en: The egg yolk gave the lemon filling a richer color than I expected.
examples.zh: 「蛋黄」让柠檬馅的颜色比我想的更浓。

words.enDefinition: the clear part of an uncooked egg surrounding the yolk

examples.en: I used the egg white in the meringue for our lemon pie.
examples.zh: 我把「蛋清」用来做柠檬派上的蛋白霜。

examples.en: The recipe asks you to whisk the egg white in a separate bowl.
examples.zh: 食谱要求把「蛋清」放在单独的碗里打发。

words.enDefinition: an ingredient or product used in place of eggs for a specified purpose

examples.en: I asked where the shop kept egg substitute for the baking class.
examples.zh: 我想买「鸡蛋替代品」上烘焙课，就问店员在哪里拿。

examples.en: The recipe lists an egg substitute that helps hold the batter together.
examples.zh: 食谱列出了一种「鸡蛋替代品」，它有助于让面糊黏合。

collocations: choose an egg substitute for baking

words.enDefinition: foods sold in a dry form, such as grains, pasta or beans

examples.en: I start with dry goods so the chilled groceries go into my bag last.
examples.zh: 我先买「干货食材」，把冷藏食品留到最后放进袋子。

examples.en: The smaller shop keeps dry goods on shelves near the baking section.
examples.zh: 小店把「干货食材」放在烘焙区附近的货架上。

words.enDefinition: a basic ingredient commonly kept on hand in a kitchen

examples.en: Rice is a pantry staple in our flat because everyone cooks it.
examples.zh: 米是我们住处的「厨房常备食材」，因为大家都会煮它。

examples.en: I bought another pantry staple before the long break when shops would close.
examples.zh: 长假前我又买了一样「厨房常备食材」，因为到时候商店会关门。

collocations: keep something as a pantry staple

words.enDefinition: rice with slender grains that generally stay separate when cooked

examples.en: I used long-grain rice in the lunch boxes we made for the trip.
examples.zh: 我们做出游便当时用了「长粒米」。

examples.en: The grocery store sells long-grain rice in bags of three different sizes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「长粒米」有三种大小的包装。

words.enDefinition: rice with short, rounded grains that often cling together when cooked

examples.en: The shop keeps short-grain rice near the ingredients for making sushi rolls.
examples.zh: 店里把「短粒米」放在寿司卷食材附近。

examples.en: I chose short-grain rice for the bowl with grilled vegetables and egg.
examples.zh: 我选「短粒米」做盖饭，上面配烤蔬菜和鸡蛋。

words.enDefinition: a variety of long-grain rice with a distinctive aroma

examples.en: I served basmati rice with the lentil dish we made on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 周二我们做了扁豆菜，配的是「巴斯马蒂香米」。

examples.en: The supermarket sells small bags of basmati rice beside the larger sacks.
examples.zh: 超市把小袋装的「巴斯马蒂香米」摆在大袋装的旁边。

words.enDefinition: a fragrant variety of long-grain rice associated especially with Thailand

examples.en: My roommate used jasmine rice for the meal we shared after class.
examples.zh: 下课后一起吃的那顿饭，室友用的是「茉莉香米」。

examples.en: I compared the price of jasmine rice in two shops near campus.
examples.zh: 我比较了学校附近两家店的「茉莉香米」价格。

collocations: serve a curry with jasmine rice

words.enDefinition: rice from which the outer husk is removed while the bran remains

examples.en: I packed brown rice with roasted vegetables for my long day at university.
examples.zh: 那天在学校要待很久，我带了「糙米」和烤蔬菜。

examples.en: The shop had brown rice in the same aisle as oats and lentils.
examples.zh: 商店把「糙米」和燕麦、扁豆放在同一条通道。

words.enDefinition: a rice variety whose grains stick together when cooked

examples.en: We bought sticky rice to make a dessert for the student society.
examples.zh: 我们买了「糯米」给学生社团做甜点。

examples.en: The small market sold sticky rice in a bag with a blue label.
examples.zh: 小市场卖的「糯米」装在带蓝色标签的袋子里。

words.enDefinition: thin noodles made from rice, used in soups, salads and stir-fries

examples.en: I bought rice vermicelli for the spring rolls we planned to make.
examples.zh: 我们打算做春卷，我就买了「细米粉」。

examples.en: The soup had rice vermicelli and several kinds of vegetables from the market.
examples.zh: 汤里有「细米粉」，还放了几种从市场买的蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: thick Japanese noodles traditionally made from wheat flour

examples.en: I bought udon noodles from the chilled shelf for our shared soup.
examples.zh: 我从冷藏货架上买了「乌冬面」，准备和大家一起吃汤面。

examples.en: The grocery store sells udon noodles in packs that serve two people.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「乌冬面」一袋够两个人吃。

words.enDefinition: Japanese noodles typically made with buckwheat flour, sometimes mixed with wheat flour

examples.en: We served soba noodles with cold dipping sauce after our afternoon picnic.
examples.zh: 下午野餐回来，我们吃了配冷蘸汁的「荞麦面条」。

examples.en: I checked the ingredients on the soba noodles because some brands use wheat.
examples.zh: 我看了「荞麦面条」的配料，因为有些牌子会用小麦。

collocations: serve soba noodles with a dipping sauce

words.enDefinition: tiny granules of wheat semolina used in North African cooking

examples.en: I packed couscous with roasted peppers in my lunch container for class.
examples.zh: 我把「库斯库斯」配烤甜椒装进饭盒，带去上课。

examples.en: The student café served couscous with a tomato stew and chickpeas.
examples.zh: 学生咖啡馆的「库斯库斯」配的是炖番茄和鹰嘴豆。

words.enDefinition: wheat grains that have been partly cooked, dried and cracked into small pieces

examples.en: I used bulgur in the salad we took to the student society picnic.
examples.zh: 我用「碎蒸小麦」做了沙拉，带去参加学生社团野餐。

examples.en: The grocery shop stocks bulgur next to the bags of rice and lentils.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「碎蒸小麦」放在袋装米和扁豆旁边。

words.enDefinition: barley grains that have been polished to remove the outer layers

examples.en: I added pearl barley to the vegetable soup we shared after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我们一起喝蔬菜汤，我在里面放了「珍珠大麦」。

examples.en: The shop sells pearl barley beside other grains in the dried foods aisle.
examples.zh: 店里的「珍珠大麦」就在干货通道其他谷物旁边。

words.enDefinition: whole oat kernels chopped into small pieces instead of flattened into flakes

examples.en: I bought steel-cut oats for a breakfast that I could prepare on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我买了「切粒燕麦」，打算周日做早餐。

examples.en: My flatmate explained why steel-cut oats take longer to cook than rolled oats.
examples.zh: 室友解释了为什么「切粒燕麦」比压片燕麦需要煮更久。

words.enDefinition: oat grains that have been steamed and flattened into flakes

examples.en: I used rolled oats in the biscuits we made for the study group.
examples.zh: 我们给学习小组做饼干时，我用了「压片燕麦」。

examples.en: The recipe listed rolled oats and sunflower seeds among the dry ingredients.
examples.zh: 食谱把「压片燕麦」和葵花籽列在干料里。

words.enDefinition: oat flakes processed to cook more quickly than ordinary rolled oats

examples.en: The shop stocked quick oats in small boxes near the instant breakfasts.
examples.zh: 店里在即食早餐食品旁边摆了小盒装的「快熟燕麦片」。

examples.en: I made a bowl of quick oats before leaving for the early bus.
examples.zh: 我赶早班公交前做了一碗「快熟燕麦片」。

words.enDefinition: flour made by grinding the whole wheat grain, including the bran and germ

examples.en: I bought wholemeal flour to make a loaf for our shared lunch.
examples.zh: 我买了「全麦面粉」，想烤个面包一起吃午饭。

examples.en: The recipe uses wholemeal flour for half of the dry mixture in the rolls.
examples.zh: 做这些面包卷时，食谱要求干料一半用「全麦面粉」。

words.enDefinition: a wheat flour intended for a wide range of ordinary baking and cooking uses

examples.en: I used all-purpose flour for the pancakes because the recipe called for it.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用「通用面粉」，所以我用它做了薄煎饼。

examples.en: The supermarket put all-purpose flour next to the packets of bread flour.
examples.zh: 超市把「通用面粉」摆在一袋袋面包粉旁边。

words.enDefinition: wheat flour sold with a raising agent already mixed into it

examples.en: I checked whether the scone recipe needed self-raising flour before going to the store.
examples.zh: 去商店之前，我查了司康食谱需不需要「自发面粉」。

examples.en: The shelf label distinguished self-raising flour from the ordinary type in a nearby bag.
examples.zh: 货架标签把「自发面粉」与旁边袋子里的普通面粉区分开。

words.enDefinition: wheat flour with relatively high protein content, used for making bread

examples.en: I bought bread flour to try making dough in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我买了「面包粉」，想在共用厨房试着和面团。

examples.en: The bakery sells a small bag of bread flour for home baking.
examples.zh: 面包店卖小袋装「面包粉」，供大家在家烘焙。

words.enDefinition: a fine wheat flour with relatively low protein, used for tender cakes

examples.en: The cake flour was kept beside the larger bags of standard flour.
examples.zh: 「蛋糕粉」就放在大袋的普通面粉旁边。

examples.en: The recipe uses cake flour to give the sponge a softer texture.
examples.zh: 食谱用「蛋糕粉」让海绵蛋糕的口感更松软。

collocations: use cake flour for a sponge

words.enDefinition: flour produced by grinding rice into a powder

examples.en: I found rice flour next to the other flours in the specialty aisle.
examples.zh: 我在特色食品通道的其他面粉旁找到了「大米粉」。

examples.en: My roommate used rice flour to make the batter for our snacks.
examples.zh: 室友用「大米粉」给我们的点心调面糊。

words.enDefinition: ground dried maize, commonly used in baking and for making dishes such as polenta

examples.en: I bought cornmeal for the loaf we planned to serve with soup.
examples.zh: 我买了「粗玉米粉」，给要配汤吃的面包用。

examples.en: The grocery store sells cornmeal in three grades with different grain sizes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「粗玉米粉」按颗粒大小分三档。

words.enDefinition: maize starch used to thicken liquids, called cornflour in British English

examples.en: I found cornstarch on the shelf near the other baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在其他烘焙食材附近的货架上找到了「玉米淀粉」。

examples.en: The recipe uses cornstarch to give the sauce a thicker consistency.
examples.zh: 食谱用「玉米淀粉」让酱汁变稠。

words.enDefinition: a dry mixture that releases gas to help dough or batter rise

examples.en: I checked that the baking powder was in the cupboard before making muffins.
examples.zh: 做松饼前，我先确认柜子里有「泡打粉」。

examples.en: The recipe lists baking powder separately from flour and the other dry ingredients.
examples.zh: 食谱把「泡打粉」和面粉等其他干料分开列出。

words.enDefinition: sodium bicarbonate used in cooking, including to help baked mixtures rise

examples.en: I used baking soda in the biscuits because the recipe contained buttermilk.
examples.zh: 食谱里的饼干含酪乳，我按要求用了「小苏打」。

examples.en: The supermarket kept baking soda on the shelf just below baking powder.
examples.zh: 超市把「小苏打」放在泡打粉下方那层货架。

collocations: add baking soda to the mixture

words.enDefinition: dried yeast granules used to make bread dough rise, often activated in liquid first

examples.en: I bought active dry yeast after reading the ingredients for the bread recipe.
examples.zh: 看完面包食谱的配料后，我买了「活性干酵母」。

examples.en: The bakery aisle had small packets of active dry yeast beside the flour.
examples.zh: 烘焙区在面粉旁边摆着小袋的「活性干酵母」。

collocations: a packet of active dry yeast
dissolve active dry yeast in water

words.enDefinition: fine dry yeast that is commonly mixed directly with dry ingredients

examples.en: I checked whether the recipe called for instant yeast before buying the packet.
examples.zh: 我在买那包酵母前，确认食谱用的是「即溶干酵母」。

examples.en: The shop sold instant yeast in a small box of individual sachets.
examples.zh: 商店的「即溶干酵母」是小盒装，里面分成了小袋。

words.enDefinition: fine-grained white sugar that dissolves more readily than regular granulated sugar

examples.en: I used caster sugar in the cake because it mixes in easily.
examples.zh: 我往蛋糕里用了「细粒白砂糖」，因为它容易拌匀。

examples.en: The recipe called for caster sugar and a little lemon zest.
examples.zh: 食谱里要用「细粒白砂糖」和一点柠檬皮屑。

words.enDefinition: white sugar sold as visible crystals of standard size

examples.en: I picked up a bag of granulated sugar for the kitchen's tea station.
examples.zh: 我拿了一袋「普通白砂糖」，放在厨房泡茶的地方。

examples.en: I stirred granulated sugar into the tea while it was still hot.
examples.zh: 茶还热的时候，我把「普通白砂糖」搅了进去。

words.enDefinition: very finely powdered sugar used for icing, dusting or other baking

examples.en: I dusted the small cakes with icing sugar before the club meeting.
examples.zh: 社团开会前，我在小蛋糕上撒了「糖粉」。

examples.en: The frosting recipe uses icing sugar because the mixture should be smooth.
examples.zh: 糖霜食谱用的是「糖粉」，因为成品应该顺滑。

words.enDefinition: sugar crystals containing molasses, giving them a brown colour and distinctive taste

examples.en: I bought brown sugar for the cookies we were baking for the fundraiser.
examples.zh: 我们要给募捐活动烤曲奇，我买了「含糖蜜的棕糖」。

examples.en: The recipe uses brown sugar to give the cake a deeper flavour.
examples.zh: 食谱用「含糖蜜的棕糖」让蛋糕的味道更浓。

words.enDefinition: a sweet syrup made by concentrating the sap of maple trees

examples.en: We poured maple syrup over the pancakes at our shared Sunday breakfast.
examples.zh: 周日一起吃早饭时，我们往薄煎饼上淋了「枫糖浆」。

examples.en: The shop sells maple syrup near the honey and other sweet spreads.
examples.zh: 商店把「枫糖浆」放在蜂蜜和其他甜味抹酱旁边。

words.enDefinition: a thick golden syrup made from sugar, common in British cooking and baking

examples.en: The British recipe listed golden syrup as an ingredient in the oat bars.
examples.zh: 那份英国食谱把「金黄糖浆」列为燕麦棒的一项配料。

examples.en: I found golden syrup in a tin near the jars of baking ingredients.
examples.zh: 我在一排瓶装烘焙食材旁找到了罐装的「金黄糖浆」。

words.enDefinition: a flavouring made by drawing aromatic compounds out of vanilla beans

examples.en: I added vanilla extract when mixing the batter for the birthday cake.
examples.zh: 我调生日蛋糕面糊时，加了「香草精」。

examples.en: The shop keeps vanilla extract in small bottles beside the food colouring.
examples.zh: 商店把小瓶装的「香草精」放在食用色素旁边。

words.enDefinition: powder made by grinding cocoa solids after removing much of the cocoa butter

examples.en: I mixed cocoa powder into the flour while making brownies with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 和室友做布朗尼时，我把「可可粉」混进了面粉。

examples.en: The shop stores cocoa powder next to flour and the other baking supplies.
examples.zh: 商店把「可可粉」摆在面粉等烘焙用品旁边。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of chocolate added to cookies, cakes or other foods

examples.en: I put chocolate chips in the biscuits we made for the club stall.
examples.zh: 我们给社团摊位做饼干，我往里面放了「巧克力豆」。

examples.en: The supermarket sold dark chocolate chips in a small resealable bag.
examples.zh: 超市有黑巧克力做的「巧克力豆」，装在可以重新封口的小袋里。

words.enDefinition: coffee beans that have been crushed or ground for brewing

examples.en: I bought ground coffee because I do not own a coffee grinder.
examples.zh: 我没有磨豆机，所以买了「研磨咖啡粉」。

examples.en: The shop keeps ground coffee on the shelf near the reusable filters.
examples.zh: 店里把「研磨咖啡粉」放在可重复使用的滤网附近。

words.enDefinition: tea leaves sold loose instead of sealed inside individual tea bags

examples.en: I used loose-leaf tea in the small pot we kept in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我用厨房里的小茶壶泡了「散装茶叶」。

examples.en: The market sold loose-leaf tea by weight from large labelled tins.
examples.zh: 市场把「散装茶叶」放在标了标签的大罐里，按重量卖。

words.enDefinition: a small porous bag containing tea leaves for making one or more servings

examples.en: I took a tea bag from the box on the kitchen shelf.
examples.zh: 我从厨房架子上的盒子里拿了一只「茶包」。

examples.en: The café let me choose a tea bag from a tray by the kettle.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆让我在水壶边的托盘里选一只「茶包」。

words.enDefinition: food packed and preserved in sealed cans

examples.en: I bought a few canned goods before the campus shop closed for break.
examples.zh: 校内商店放假关门前，我买了几样「罐装食品」。

examples.en: The donation box accepted canned goods such as beans, vegetables and soup.
examples.zh: 捐赠箱接收豆类、蔬菜和汤等「罐装食品」。

words.enDefinition: tomatoes preserved in cans, available whole, chopped or crushed

examples.en: I used canned tomatoes in the sauce we made for our pasta.
examples.zh: 我们给意面做酱汁时，我用了「罐装番茄」。

examples.en: The shop sells canned tomatoes in both whole and chopped varieties.
examples.zh: 商店的「罐装番茄」有整颗和切碎两种。

collocations: add canned tomatoes to a sauce

words.enDefinition: a smooth liquid made from tomatoes that have been puréed and strained

examples.en: I used passata as the base for our simple tomato and basil sauce.
examples.zh: 我用「番茄原浆」做了简单的番茄罗勒酱。

examples.en: The grocery shop sold passata in tall glass bottles next to canned tomatoes.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「番茄原浆」装在高玻璃瓶里，摆在番茄罐头旁。

words.enDefinition: a thick concentrate made by cooking tomatoes down and removing much of their water

examples.en: I added tomato paste to make the lentil stew taste more of tomato.
examples.zh: 我给炖扁豆加了「浓缩番茄膏」，让番茄味更浓。

examples.en: The shop sold tomato paste in small tubes beside jars of sauce.
examples.zh: 店里的「浓缩番茄膏」装在小管里，摆在瓶装酱汁旁边。

words.enDefinition: a small solid concentrate that dissolves in water to make stock

examples.en: I dropped a stock cube into the pot before adding the vegetables.
examples.zh: 我先把一块「高汤块」放进锅里，然后再加蔬菜。

examples.en: The grocery store had a vegetable stock cube beside the chicken flavour.
examples.zh: 杂货店有蔬菜口味的「高汤块」，就放在鸡味的旁边。

words.enDefinition: a savoury liquid made by simmering vegetables, used as a cooking base

examples.en: We used vegetable stock as the base for the soup we made together.
examples.zh: 我们一起煮汤时，用「蔬菜高汤」做汤底。

examples.en: The recipe calls for vegetable stock to be added gradually to the rice.
examples.zh: 食谱要求把「蔬菜高汤」分次加进米饭里。

collocations: use vegetable stock as a base

words.enDefinition: a savoury liquid made by cooking chicken in water, used in soups or other dishes

examples.en: The recipe used chicken broth to give the noodles a more savoury taste.
examples.zh: 食谱用「清鸡汤」给面条增加鲜味。

examples.en: I opened a carton of chicken broth before chopping vegetables for the soup.
examples.zh: 给汤切蔬菜之前，我打开了一盒「清鸡汤」。

words.enDefinition: beans cooked or preserved in a sealed can

examples.en: I used canned beans for the salad because I had very little time.
examples.zh: 我时间不多，就用「罐装豆类」做沙拉。

examples.en: My flatmate put canned beans on the list alongside rice and tomato paste.
examples.zh: 室友把「罐装豆类」、米和浓缩番茄膏一起写进了购物清单。

words.enDefinition: beans with most of their moisture removed for storage before cooking

examples.en: The shop sells dried beans in bags beside the lentils and rice.
examples.zh: 商店把袋装「干豆」放在扁豆和米旁边。

examples.en: I chose dried beans for the stew we were planning for Sunday.
examples.zh: 我挑了「干豆」，打算周日做炖菜。

words.enDefinition: beans with a black outer skin, especially common in Latin American cooking

examples.en: I added black beans to the rice bowls we packed for lunch.
examples.zh: 我往午饭的饭盒里加了「黑芸豆」配米饭。

examples.en: The shop has black beans in both cans and bags of dried beans.
examples.zh: 店里的「黑芸豆」有罐装，也有袋装干豆。

words.enDefinition: beans shaped like a kidney, commonly available in red or white varieties

examples.en: We added kidney beans to the tomato stew for our student society dinner.
examples.zh: 我们给学生社团聚餐做炖番茄，往里加了「芸豆」。

examples.en: I found kidney beans in a can next to the chickpeas and lentils.
examples.zh: 我在鹰嘴豆和扁豆旁边找到了罐装「芸豆」。

collocations: add kidney beans to a stew

words.enDefinition: round beige pulses used in dishes such as hummus and curries

examples.en: I used chickpeas to make a spread for sandwiches on the picnic.
examples.zh: 我用「鹰嘴豆」做了一份抹酱，野餐时抹在三明治里。

examples.en: The supermarket sold chickpeas beside the other canned beans on the lower shelf.
examples.zh: 超市把「鹰嘴豆」和其他罐装豆类放在下面那层货架。

words.enDefinition: small orange or reddish lentils that soften and break down readily when cooked

examples.en: I used red lentils to make a thicker soup for the evening meal.
examples.zh: 我用「红扁豆」给晚饭做了更浓稠的汤。

examples.en: The grocer sold red lentils in clear bags on the shelf above the rice.
examples.zh: 杂货店的「红扁豆」装在透明袋里，放在米上方的货架。

words.enDefinition: dried peas that have had their outer skins removed and been split into halves

examples.en: My roommate bought split peas for a thick soup on a cold day.
examples.zh: 室友买了「干去皮豌豆瓣」，天冷时煮浓汤。

examples.en: The grocery shop displayed green split peas next to the red lentils.
examples.zh: 杂货店把绿色的「干去皮豌豆瓣」和红扁豆摆在一起。

words.enDefinition: a smooth paste made from ground sesame seeds, common in Middle Eastern cooking

examples.en: I put a spoonful of tahini in the dressing for our lunch salad.
examples.zh: 我往午餐沙拉的酱汁里加了一勺「中东芝麻酱」。

examples.en: The supermarket stocks tahini beside the jars of nut butter and spreads.
examples.zh: 超市把「中东芝麻酱」放在罐装坚果酱等抹酱旁。

words.enDefinition: a spread made from ground peanuts

examples.en: I spread peanut butter on toast before leaving for the early bus.
examples.zh: 赶早班公交前，我在吐司上抹了「花生酱」。

examples.en: My flatmate bought crunchy peanut butter because we had finished the smooth kind.
examples.zh: 室友买了带颗粒的「花生酱」，因为顺滑的那种已经吃完了。

words.enDefinition: a white liquid made from the flesh of coconuts, often used in cooking

examples.en: We used coconut milk to make the sauce for our vegetable curry.
examples.zh: 我们用「椰浆」给咖喱蔬菜做酱汁。

examples.en: I found coconut milk in cans near the other ingredients for curries.
examples.zh: 我在其他咖喱食材附近找到了罐装「椰浆」。

collocations: use coconut milk in a curry

words.enDefinition: a thick coconut product generally richer in coconut fat than coconut milk

examples.en: The recipe used coconut cream to make the dessert filling thicker and richer.
examples.zh: 食谱用「浓椰浆」让甜点的馅更浓稠。

examples.en: The shop put coconut cream beside the thinner coconut milk on the shelf.
examples.zh: 商店把「浓椰浆」放在更稀的椰浆旁边。

words.enDefinition: fruit with much of its original water removed, usually for preservation

examples.en: I mixed dried fruit with nuts for the walk to the field site.
examples.zh: 我把「果干」和坚果混在一起，带着步行去实地考察。

examples.en: The shop sells dried fruit in small sealed packets near the cereal.
examples.zh: 商店把小袋密封装的「果干」放在早餐麦片旁边。

words.enDefinition: dried grapes, often used as a snack or in cooking and baking

examples.en: I added raisins to the oat bars we made for the student picnic.
examples.zh: 我们给学生野餐做燕麦棒时，我加了些「葡萄干」。

examples.en: The recipe asked for raisins and chopped walnuts in the sweet bread.
examples.zh: 做那款甜面包时，食谱要求加「葡萄干」和碎核桃。

words.enDefinition: small edible seeds that absorb liquid and form a gel

examples.en: I added chia seeds to the yogurt mixture for tomorrow's breakfast.
examples.zh: 我往准备明天早餐吃的酸奶里加了「奇亚籽」。

examples.en: The grocery store sells chia seeds beside other seeds in the cereal aisle.
examples.zh: 杂货店在早餐麦片通道，把「奇亚籽」和其他籽类放在一起卖。

words.enDefinition: the small edible seed of the flax plant

examples.en: The recipe used ground flaxseed to add texture to the homemade oat bars.
examples.zh: 食谱用磨碎的「亚麻籽」为自制燕麦棒增加口感。

examples.en: I found flaxseed on the lower shelf beside the packets of other seeds.
examples.zh: 我在下面一层货架上其他籽类包装旁边找到了「亚麻籽」。

words.enDefinition: olive oil from mechanical extraction that meets specified quality and flavour standards

examples.en: I used extra virgin olive oil in the dressing for our tomato salad.
examples.zh: 我用「特级初榨橄榄油」给番茄沙拉做调味汁。

examples.en: The deli sold extra virgin olive oil in small dark glass bottles.
examples.zh: 熟食店的「特级初榨橄榄油」装在深色小玻璃瓶里。

collocations: a bottle of extra virgin olive oil
dress a salad with extra virgin olive oil

words.enDefinition: a cooking oil with little distinctive flavour of its own

examples.en: The recipe asked for neutral oil to let the lemon flavour stand out.
examples.zh: 食谱要求用「风味清淡的食用油」，让柠檬味更突出。

examples.en: I used neutral oil to grease the pan for the sponge cake.
examples.zh: 烤海绵蛋糕之前，我用「风味清淡的食用油」给模具抹了一层。

words.enDefinition: vinegar made by fermenting liquid from apples

examples.en: I used apple cider vinegar in the dressing for the shredded cabbage.
examples.zh: 我用「苹果醋」给切丝的卷心菜调酱汁。

examples.en: The bottle of apple cider vinegar was stored with the oils and sauces.
examples.zh: 那瓶「苹果醋」和油、酱汁放在一起。

collocations: a bottle of apple cider vinegar

words.enDefinition: vinegar made from fermented rice, common in several East Asian cuisines

examples.en: We mixed rice vinegar into the dressing for the cold cucumber salad.
examples.zh: 我们在凉拌黄瓜的调料里拌进了「米醋」。

examples.en: The grocery shop placed rice vinegar beside the different kinds of soy sauce.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「米醋」摆在各类酱油旁边。

collocations: add rice vinegar to a dressing

words.enDefinition: a thinner Chinese soy sauce used mainly for flavouring and seasoning

examples.en: I added light soy sauce to the dressing for our noodle salad.
examples.zh: 我在凉拌面的调料里加了「生抽」。

examples.en: The shop keeps light soy sauce separately from the darker type used for colour.
examples.zh: 商店把「生抽」和用来上色的深色酱油分开摆放。

collocations: a splash of light soy sauce

words.enDefinition: a dark Chinese soy sauce often used to give dishes a deeper colour

examples.en: My flatmate used dark soy sauce to give the braised dish a darker colour.
examples.zh: 室友用「老抽」给炖菜上色，颜色更深。

examples.en: The label on the dark soy sauce was easy to spot from the aisle.
examples.zh: 站在通道里很容易看到「老抽」瓶上的标签。

collocations: a bottle of dark soy sauce
colour a sauce with dark soy sauce

words.enDefinition: a salty liquid seasoning usually made by fermenting fish with salt

examples.en: I added fish sauce to the dressing we served with the noodle salad.
examples.zh: 我们的凉拌面配调味汁，我往里面加了「鱼露」。

examples.en: The recipe uses fish sauce with lime juice and a little sugar.
examples.zh: 食谱用「鱼露」搭配青柠汁和少量糖。

words.enDefinition: a thick savoury seasoning traditionally made with oyster extracts

examples.en: We added oyster sauce to the vegetables we made in the shared kitchen.
examples.zh: 我们在共用厨房炒蔬菜时加了「蚝油」。

examples.en: The grocery shop had oyster sauce beside the other bottled cooking sauces.
examples.zh: 杂货店把「蚝油」放在其他瓶装烹调酱料旁边。

words.enDefinition: a French-style mustard with a smooth texture and a distinctive sharp flavour

examples.en: I used Dijon mustard to make a dressing for the potato salad.
examples.zh: 我用「第戎芥末酱」给土豆沙拉做调味汁。

examples.en: The small jar of Dijon mustard was near the pickles at the shop.
examples.zh: 店里小罐装的「第戎芥末酱」放在腌菜附近。

words.enDefinition: ground dried peppers made smoky during drying, used to season food

examples.en: I added smoked paprika to the chickpeas before putting them in the oven.
examples.zh: 把鹰嘴豆放进烤箱前，我加了「烟熏甜椒粉」。

examples.en: The grocery store sold smoked paprika in a small tin beside the other spices.
examples.zh: 杂货店的小罐「烟熏甜椒粉」就在其他香料旁边。

words.enDefinition: powder made from cumin seeds and used as an aromatic spice

examples.en: I added ground cumin to the lentil soup we cooked for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们煮扁豆汤当晚饭，我加了「孜然粉」。

examples.en: The packet of ground cumin was on the top shelf near the curry powder.
examples.zh: 那包「孜然粉」放在最上层货架，靠近咖喱粉。
